description: Submit a structured move, build, scavenge, sabotage, chat, alliance, trade, or resign action to Junkyard Metropolis. Requires the play scope. Send a client-generated move_id UUID so retries are idempotent.

move_id.description: Client-generated UUID for this move. Retries with the same move_id are idempotent.
